prior_summary: Fresh measured TCP body-frame command transforms provide a feedback-like Cartesian action representation for tilted handoff and feasible off-nominal intermediate states.
applicable_conditions: Prefer at the demonstrated moderately tilted entry or after a policy switch into an unusual but still securely grasped and reachable intermediate state. Source, destination, TCP, and measured joints must be reliable.
termination_guidance: Continue through observed support, opening, and retreat; terminate only when the source is upright and stationary inside return bounds, fingers are open, and TCP is clear. Do not infer success from a local command alone.
limitations: Successful nominal paths only; no lost-grasp, collision, failed placement, or release recovery. Local transforms can drift or oscillate and do not directly construct invariance to a large target displacement. Contact is inferred only from causal geometry.

config.reference_frame: fresh measured TCP at every executed slot
config.action_encoding: body translation plus rotation_vector plus gripper
